lines.1: 「Kurogane--written with the character for iron. Otome Kurogane.」
lines.2: 「Revenge is my specialty. I'll pay you back for this humiliation! Someday I'll make you cry instead!」
lines.3: 「You still have not learned your lesson after all that?」
lines.4: 「You truly have remarkable spirit. I like that.」
lines.6: (Yeah. Loves lectures, loves talking. Not my kind of person.)
lines.7: 「I have given you no cause for revenge, but it would be wrong to disregard such fiery determination.」
lines.8: 「Very well. I am in Class 3-A. I will neither run nor hide. Come whenever you have time--between classes or after school. I will face you anytime.」
lines.9: 「Hmph! Remember this! If you hear one extra set of footsteps behind you on a dark street, that's me!」
